title: Future Announces ‘THE REAL ME’ Album Release Date: ‘Album of the Century’
summary: Pluto will kick off the album rollout with a single titled "Radio" first thing Friday (June 26).
contentText:
Future season has returned. The Atlanta rap dignitary announced on Thursday (June 25) that his THE REAL ME album is slated to be released on July 10.

“Album of the century JULY 10th,” he declared in a post to X. In a separate tweet, Future promised that a “Pluto summer” is on the way.

Album of the century JULY 10th

— FUTURE/FREEBANDZ (@1future) June 25, 2026

Pluto Summer #THEREALME

To set the album’s rollout in motion, Future’s set to release the project’s lead single first thing Friday, which is titled “Radio.” He teased the track’s music video on his Instagram Story , which will also arrive on Friday.

“This not for the radio,” he half-croons. “The biggest n—a in town, even when I’m not in town.”

Future made THE REAL ME official with an announcement earlier this month on June 15. “Album title: THE REAL ME,” he wrote to X while confirming the LP’s title.

THE REAL ME will serve as Future’s first album since going back-to-back with  We Don’t Trust You  and  We Still Don’t Trust You  in 2024, both of which debuted at No. 1 on the  Billboard 200 and featured Metro Boomin  as the sole producer.

Future has been making noise while gearing up for the project. In May, he squashed his feud with  Drake  as the What a Time to Be Alive collaborators reunited on  ICEMAN  standout “Ran to Atlanta,” which peaked at No. 2 on the  Billboard Hot 100 .

Hendrix also crafted a  FIFA World Cup 2026 anthem  with Tyla titled “Game Time.” The duo performed the track for the first time earlier in June at SoFi Stadium for the World Cup’s Opening Ceremony in Inglewood, Calif.

DJ Khaled  also recruited Future and  Lil Baby  for “One of Them” in April, which landed at No. 70 on the  Billboard Hot 100  and will appear on Khaled’s upcoming Aalam of God  album.
